title: Explicit replication and falsification
summary: Reconstruct a published procedure, inspect input availability and record exact departures.
assumptions: Target claim, implementation lineage and acceptance criterion are fixed.
controls: Independent implementation where possible; retained failures; code and data hashes.
limitations: A same-author rerun is reproducibility checking, not independent human validation.
cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.
